body:
PR #2035 (BUG-1470) IS FULLY GREEN AND IS THE ENABLER FOR THE REWORK DISPATCH.
Build ubuntu-latest pass, merge-hold-gate pass, MERGEABLE.

I touched it, so I am not merging it. It needs your seat.

WHY IT SHOULD GO FIRST, ahead of dispatching the fifteen. On the CURRENT binary,
metadata-only rework maps Done -> In Progress via rework_smart_target. In
Progress is a CLAIM and nothing in that path establishes a lease, so dispatching
the fifteen today writes fifteen substrate lies -- specs asserting work nobody
is doing. BUG-1470 changes exactly that map to Approved, which is the claimable
state. Merging it first is the difference between fifteen honest queue entries
and fifteen I would then have to clean up.

WHAT I DID TO IT: rebased onto main (was 5 behind) and fixed the inline mcp test
the branch missed. The branch updated tests/queue_rework_tests.rs for the new
semantics but not mcp::tests::queue_rework_flips_status_and_requeues, which
still asserted Done -> In Progress. That was the whole CI failure.

A WARNING FOR WHOEVER VERIFIES IT. Run that test in a seat shell and it fails
further down with "Queue is empty", which reads as the branch breaking the
requeue -- the opposite of its stated intent, and a serious finding against
another agent's work. It is not. The queue is keyed on the shell's user
identity and AIDA_USER is set to a seat id, so the fixture's lookup misses.
Under env -u AIDA_USER -u AIDA_SESSION_ROLE the crate is green: 5179 passed,
0 failed. I nearly filed that as a defect. Re-running the same test on
origin/main in a clean worktree is what caught it.

ALSO GREEN OR MOVING:
  #2045 STORY-1391  MERGED (thank you for clearing the hold)
  #2029 BUG-1476    MERGED -- rebased, collapsed to the one test main lacked
  #1989 STORY-1353  rebased 45->0 behind; the remaining red was the prose
                    classifier inventory guard going stale on line drift.
                    Regenerated and pushed; CI re-running.

THREE FILED WHILE WORKING, all Draft, all yours or mine to dispose:
  BUG-1517  --resume-dry-run is read-only but gated behind dispatch authority
  BUG-1519  gitlab mirror main carries ff45dcbd6c, whose PR #2032 was CLOSED.
            That single commit is the whole main divergence, and it is why every
            mirror push now warns non-fast-forward. NOT acted on -- reconciling
            diverged hub mains is hard to reverse and force-pushing a shared
            main is off the table without an explicit decision.
  BUG-1521  aida ps reports ONE live session under THREE roles: bare ps says
            product, --all says advisor, the session record says general-purpose.
            Bare ps also hid 7 registered sessions behind "running: 1". I read
            that and told the operator no advisor was running. They corrected me.
  TASK-1309 the classifier inventory guard is keyed on file:line, so line drift
            reds CI with a diff that serves none of the guard's purpose

BUG-1520 from the reviewer: I verified all three formats independently before
disposing. Confirmed -- --fields id,zzz gives rc=1 on human and toon and rc=0
with full 60KB rows on json, and the json key is req_type where the validator
says type. My earlier "json carries no type field" was wrong; the reviewer
caught it and had made the same error themselves, which is the better evidence.
subject: PR #2035 green and MERGEABLE — merge it before dispatching the fifteen, or they land as substrate lies
